newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys Apr MTBE from SABIC at $280-$283/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys Apr MTBE from SABIC at $280-$283/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) has bought by tender 7,000 tonnes of methyl tertiary butyl ether (MTBE) for April 6-20 at $280-$283 per tonne cost-and-freight Taiwan, from Saudi Basic Industries Corp (SABIC), industry sources said on Wednesday.
SABIC sources were unable to confirm the award until they receive CPC's confirmation later Wednesday.
A CPC official told Reuters around five offers were received for the tender which closed March 3 and sought the cargo for delivery to Kaohsiung and Keelung.
The official said the prices were reasonable, and lower than CPC's last tender for March 1-15 delivery at $283 c-and-f.
